(2) The scene cuts to a high-angle shot of a fossilized jawbone, identified as Penghu 1, resting inside a white storage box. The fossil is dark brown and textured, displaying several teeth. Overlays of scientific diagrams and a screenshot of an article from the journal 'Science' appear briefly. The Penghu site is highlighted near the center. (5) The video shows historical footage or a secondary recording inside a museum setting. (4) [Subtitle]: 這塊化石被命名為澎湖原人 或編號 Penghu 1. (5) [Subtitle]: 日本、台灣和丹麥的研究團隊 使用古蛋白質分析技術. (6) [Subtitle]: 這具化石竟然是丹尼索瓦人的男性遺骸. (7) [Subtitle]: 這份研究甚至上了國際期刊 Science. (8) [Subtitle]: 澎湖化石改寫丹尼索瓦人足跡. (9) [Subtitle]: 國立自然科學博物館. (10) [Slogan]: 科博館將在 5月22日 舉辦丹尼索瓦人到台灣的特展.
